reason: A structured HTTP request plugin for model or Code Mode use, supporting arbitrary HTTP/HTTPS methods, authentication, JSON handling, and response metadata; human review is warranted because it lacks SSRF restrictions and can reach internal or cloud metadata endpoints.

summaries.zh: 用于执行结构化 HTTP/HTTPS 请求的插件，支持常用请求方法、自定义请求头、JSON 数据、认证参数、超时控制及响应解析。
summaries.en: A structured HTTP/HTTPS request plugin supporting common methods, custom headers, JSON payloads, authentication helpers, timeouts, and response parsing.

capabilities: Sends arbitrary HTTP and HTTPS requests using multiple methods
Supports custom headers, raw or JSON request bodies, and Bearer or Basic authentication
Parses and truncates response bodies while reporting status, timing, size, and selected headers
Can access localhost, loopback, private-network, link-local, and cloud metadata endpoints without SSRF filtering
